description: Calendar to pick a date or a range, with limits and navigation between months.

howToUse: Use it when the calendar stays open on the screen: booking, availability, a period for a report.
Use `mode="range"` for start and end, with `numberOfMonths={2}` so both fit side by side.
Block the days that cannot be chosen with `min` and `max`.
Set `weekStartsOn` and `locale` for the country of the people using it.
alternatives: A date inside a form, where the calendar opens from a field: DatePicker.

keyboard.action: Goes to the previous or next month.

props.name: mode
props.description: `single` (one date) or `range` (start → end, e.g. round trip).

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value. `Date | null` in single mode; `DateRange` in range mode.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fired on each selection. `Date` in single, `DateRange` in range.

props.name: numberOfMonths
props.description: How many months side by side (useful in range). Default 1.

props.name: fixedWeeks
props.description: Keeps six weeks for a fixed height; false uses the month's weeks.

props.name: month
props.description: Controlled visible month (1st day of the month).

props.name: monthLabelStyle
props.description: Month label: "long" uses the language format ("October 2026"); "compact" joins only month and year ("October 2026"). Default "long".
